description: Стандартный 3-stone Grand Winery (Valdemar). Ставить vs French, Jeanne (JD), Malians — и vs Golden Horde, Rus, Sengoku, Delhi (mill туда не открывать). Жадный: трое на камне, умирает от spear rush — тогда mill Hippodrome D7Jsk12Fl2FCyiJf7q9L. Feudal 4:38. VOD 0pkvLN16f4o, катка 1 vs China (копья у China слабые).
name: [1x1][OPEN][BYZ][TEMPO] Valdemar: Grand Winery 3 Stone
author: Valdemar1902 / Valdy

notes: 3 на @resource/resource_stone.webp@, 1 на @resource/resource_gold.webp@, 1 ставит @building_economy/house.webp@ + @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ в зоне ТЦ, затем на @resource/sheep.webp@.
@unit_cavalry/scout.webp@: ягоды по бокам и олени. На Flankwoods камень/золото сзади. 3-stone vs French / Jeanne / Malians / China — у них нет сильного spear opener.
Винодельню позже на свои ягоды. Копья на камне = сразу mill BO, не этот.
@resource/rally.webp@ на @resource/sheep.webp@ до феодала.
2-я @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ и @building_byzantines/aqueduct-1.webp@. Аквидукт обычно едой; если каменьщик рядом — им.
3-я @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@. Камня хватает на 4 цистерны — дальше флот.
4 с @resource/sheep.webp@ на @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ (vs China 4). Если сами делаем копья vs French/Jeanne knights — ап с 2–3, не с 4.
1 на золоте всю тёмную эпоху. 8 на дерево после клика, остальное еда.
Снять камень на страглеры. На 100 камня — 4-я @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@.
@resource/rally.webp@ страглеры до 8 дерева. Золото снять после 35g на ап @unit_byzantines/limitanei-1.webp@.
@building_economy/house.webp@. Аквидукт → ягоды. Центральная цистерна: research, остальные: production speed.
Feudal. Вся еда на ягоды у @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@. Казармы, если скаут видит лучников/конницу.
@building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.webp@. Контракт: @unit_byzantines/javelin-thrower-2.webp@ vs рыцари; иначе @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@.
Комплект: longbow + spear + horseman. Vs French/JD: spear + jav. Longbows дешевле — пачка по 4.
Очередь @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@. ~12 на еде. Не бить barbican — играть как English: харраст дерева, свои ягоды, потом castle.
@building_military/blacksmith.webp@: @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ и @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@. 4 на золото, закрыть ещё ягоды. Ап копий.
@building_military/outpost.webp@ + @building_economy/mill.webp@ + 5-я @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ на 2-х ягодах 5 жителями.
@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@. Три патча ягод → castle. Не форсить урон — оппонент должен ошибиться.
Стоп юнитов. Макро в castle: 2–3 дерево, остальное еда/золото.

8–12 на @landmark_byzantines/golden-horn-tower-2.webp@ + @building_military/stable.webp@. Дерево на @building_religious/monastery.webp@, затем @unit_byzantines/cataphract-3.webp@ + longbows, реликвии.
Апы цистерн влетают быстро — это окно урона. Castle ~12–13 мин.

map: Flankwoods и открытые гибридные карты с безопасным задним камнем
strategy: 3-stone Grand Winery, olive oil, longbow/spear/horseman, Castle ~13:05
reasoning: Valdemar: 3-stone vs French / Jeanne / Malians и vs civs с которых mill не открывают (Golden Horde, Rus, Sengoku, Delhi). China в VOD — копья слабые. Не контрит spear opener: трое на камне. Vs English/Ottoman/HRE/Japanese spear — mill Hippodrome.

tactics.title: 3 stone vs French / Jeanne / Malians, not vs spears
tactics.detail: Valdemar’s default 3-stone: French, Jeanne, Malians, plus China (spears are weak there). Three vills on exposed stone die to a spear rush — then switch to the mill BO. Vs French/Jeanne YOU may make spears vs their knights and age with 2–3 vills; they are not spear openers.

tactics.title: Age up 4 vs China; 2–3 if you spear vs knights
tactics.detail: One gold villager banks the entire Dark Age. 4 vs China. Default 3. Age with 2 if YOU queue spears vs French/Jeanne royal knights — that is your counter, not their opener.

tactics.title: Stone only for four cisterns
tactics.detail: Pull stone at 100, drop the 4th cistern, then stragglers to 8 wood. Extra stone just floats.

tactics.title: Center cistern research, others production
tactics.detail: Flip the middle cistern to research and the rest to production speed before Feudal production.

tactics.title: Play like English: longbow wood harass
tactics.detail: Do not dive a barbican. Longbows are cheaper — queue four. Secure three berry patches, then Castle. Song Dynasty into this is a free win.

tactics.title: Stop units at 11:00, Castle ~12–13 min
tactics.detail: 2–3 on wood, rest food/gold. Golden Horn + stable, cistern-scaled upgrades, then the damage window.

transcriptText:
[00:19] vs China on Flankwoods — 3-stone Winery is allowed because China cannot really open spears.
[00:43] Open 3 stone, 1 gold; Winery later on these berries.
[02:08] One gold villager for the whole Dark Age. Age up with 3, or 2 if spears vs French/JD; this matchup 4.
[02:16] Then 8 on wood, rest food. Longbow / spear / horseman. Spear+jav vs French/JD.
[02:51] Castle around 12 minutes. Mill opener is useful now; Triumph is very powerful.
[03:32] Pull stone at 100, fourth cistern. Only gather for four cisterns or you float stone.
[03:59] Keep one on gold for the spear upgrade.
[04:23] Middle cistern research, others production speed.
[04:46] Barracks if scout sees archers/horsemen.
[05:54] Get the four longbows — cheaper now.
[06:57] Play as if English: longbows, harass wood, berries, Castle.
[08:04] Fifth cistern. Three berry patches then Castle.
[08:36] Wheelbarrow. Do not slow yourself trying to force damage.
[09:36] He went Song — the game is over.
[10:19] That was the Vinarii triple-stone opener.
